display_title: [Humiliation BL Anthology] The Count's Tutor's Circumstances
description:
Evan became a tutor in the renowned Frost family household. The Frost family had two sons: the eldest, Theodore, and the second son, Darren. While teaching the brothers, Evan fell in love with Theodore, and after becoming an adult, he remained by his side as his aide.

 *“I love you, Evan.”

'Damn it, I liked him first.'*

But the second son, Darren, who secretly harbored feelings for Evan, grew jealous of their affection. 

 *“Just you wait. I'll take him away from you, no matter what it takes.”*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

*Note: Part of Daiwon's Neungyonk BL Danpyeon (능욕BL단편) Collection.*
